description: How long an order of this protocol takes from one chain to another, measured from delivered orders (fees where the protocol exposes them; a transfer’s price across bridges is /v1/compare). Returns: { protocol, src_chain, dst_chain, time: { delivered_stage, p50_s, p90_s, n }, fees, fees_note }; 404 for a path with no delivered order in the window. (GET /v1/protocol/:protocol/quote)
